description: Independent Go code pairs with functional differences verified on enumerated integer inputs; output labels must not be inferred from Hamming distance.

cases.original: func Sum(a, b int) int { return a + b }
cases.equivalent: func Sum(x, y int) int { return x + y }
cases.changed: func Sum(a, b int) int { return a - b }

cases.original: func Product(a, b int) int { return a * b }
cases.equivalent: func Product(x, y int) int { return (x * y) }
cases.changed: func Product(a, b int) int { return a + b }

cases.original: func Weighted(a, b int) int { return a + (b * 2) }
cases.equivalent: func Weighted(x, y int) int { return (2 * y) + x }
cases.changed: func Weighted(a, b int) int { return a + (b * 3) }

cases.original: func Choose(a, b int) int { if a > b { return a }; return b }
cases.equivalent: func Choose(x, y int) int { if y < x { return x }; return y }
cases.changed: func Choose(a, b int) int { if a < b { return a }; return b }

cases.original: func Difference(a, b int) int { return a - b }
cases.equivalent: func Difference(x, y int) int { return x + (-y) }
cases.changed: func Difference(a, b int) int { return b - a }
